details: For finite concept classes on a domain of size n at least 2, Hamming radius is at least log-size divided by log n.
proof_source: Full proof in the LaTeX survey: Lemma `lem:basic-parameter-relationships`.
name: Hamming Radius / Log Size
witness_verification: For the family #classes/trivial_concepts with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $\lceil n/2\rceil$ and $1$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity as n tends to infinity, ruling out every reverse affine-linear bound. See the database-owned value proofs for these two endpoints.
